summary: The news-grown share bar (45%) now leaves named voyages out of its denominator: Milestone 2's named voyages (Salvage, Hold the Core, Bounty) sit on every board by design, so they diluted the share to 44% once Bounty went on the board. Unnamed work is measured exactly as before (69% now). VoyageDepthHarness.NamedJobs; NotorietyPutsAPriceOnTheArkAndItFades also accepts a named Bounty that hunts another crew.
